ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail of child care fraud, looking for patterns and connections between entities and programs.
questions: What are the most common schemes used by child care fraudsters?
How can regulators and law enforcement better detect and prevent child care fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the scope and complexity of child care fraud and identify areas for improvement in regulation and oversight.
